phenomenon_summary: Partial sensory cues entering the hippocampus via entorhinal cortex are completed into the full stored memory pattern by recurrent excitation among CA3 pyramidal neurons, with the reinstated attractor pattern read out via CA1.

units.name: PartialCue_EC2
units.description: Entorhinal layer II stellate cells delivering a partial/degraded sensory cue via the perforant path.

units.name: EntorhinalCortexL2
units.description: Entorhinal cortex layer II region; source of perforant path input to DG and CA3.

units.name: DG_GranuleCells
units.description: Sparse, decorrelated granule cell code; drives CA3 via mossy fibers (detonator synapses) during encoding.

units.name: DG_MossyCells
units.description: Hilar mossy cells providing associational excitation/inhibition within DG.

units.name: DentateGyrus
units.description: Dentate gyrus region performing pattern separation prior to CA3.

units.name: CA3_Pyramidal
units.description: CA3 pyramidal neurons forming the auto-associative recurrent collateral network with NMDAR-dependent plasticity.

units.name: CA3_PVBasket
units.description: PV+ basket interneurons providing feedforward and feedback inhibition that controls sparsity and gain in CA3.

units.name: CA3
units.description: Hippocampal CA3 region; Marr/Hopfield-style auto-associative attractor network.

units.name: CA1_Pyramidal
units.description: CA1 pyramidal neurons reading out the completed CA3 attractor pattern via Schaffer collaterals.

units.name: CA1_PVBasket
units.description: PV+ basket interneurons providing feedforward inhibition in CA1.

units.name: CA1
units.description: Hippocampal CA1 region; output stage of the hippocampal trisynaptic loop.

units.name: RecalledPattern
units.description: Reinstated complete memory representation observed as stable CA1 place-cell/ensemble activity.

interactions.description: Perforant path to DG (pattern separation pathway).
Direct perforant path input to CA3 — delivers the partial cue used to seed completion.
Sparse mossy fiber detonator synapses drive CA3 (dominant during encoding).
Granule cell drive to hilar mossy cells.
Mossy cell associational feedback to granule cells.
Recurrent collateral excitation with NMDAR-dependent Hebbian plasticity — the auto-associative substrate of pattern completion.
Recurrent drive of PV basket cells.
Feedback inhibition controlling sparsity and stabilising attractor states.
Schaffer collaterals carry the completed CA3 pattern to CA1.
Schaffer collateral feedforward inhibition via PV interneurons.
CA1 ensemble activity expresses the recalled, completed memory.

parameters.name: cue_completeness
parameters.role: Fraction of original cue features present at recall (controls completion difficulty).

parameters.name: CA3_recurrent_strength
parameters.role: Effective gain of CA3->CA3 recurrent excitation; knocked down in CA3-NR1 KO.

parameters.name: NMDAR_plasticity
parameters.role: NMDAR-dependent Hebbian plasticity at CA3 recurrent synapses.

parameters.name: sparsity
parameters.role: Target activity sparsity enforced by PV inhibition.

notes: Multiscale: cell-type units (scale 0) are grouped under region units (scale 1: DentateGyrus, CA3, CA1, EntorhinalCortexL2). Key feedback loops marked recurrent: CA3 recurrent collaterals, CA3 pyramidal<->PV basket inhibitory loop, and DG granule<->mossy cell loop. time_steps=6 reflects several iterations of recurrent CA3 dynamics needed for attractor convergence.
